text:
The court will likely not allow the prosecution to use prior consistent statements to rehabilitate the witness, because the impeachment here is based on prior inconsistent statements and an accusation of fabrication for trial, not on a charge of recent fabrication or improper motive that would permit rehabilitation with prior consistent statements. Since the prior consistent statements do not predate the alleged motive to fabricate and would merely bolster credibility, they remain inadmissible.  
CONFIDENCE: 90
